mapper.select: SELECT ol.id, ol.user_id, ol.operation, ol.target_type, ol.target_id, ol.operation_time, ol.ip_address, ol.detail FROM operation_log ol WHERE ol.operation IN ( 'DELETE_USER', 'DELETE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE', 'DELETE_DOCUMENT', 'UPDATE_USER_STATUS', 'ARCHIVE_DOCUMENT', 'BULK_DELETE' ) ORDER BY ol.operation_time DESC LIMIT 100
